blocks.content:
Evaluation behavior sets how often Grafana runs your query, how long a problem must last before the alert fires, and how long the alert keeps firing after the condition resolves.

In this milestone, you create an evaluation group, set a pending period, and set keep firing for.
In the **Set evaluation behavior** section, click **New evaluation group** to open the dialog.
Give the group a name, such as **Alerts group**, set the **Evaluation interval** to **1m**, then click **Create**.
Find the **Pending period** field. This is how long the condition must stay true before the alert fires. Set it to **1m** — brief spikes get filtered out, but a real problem fires quickly.

Find the **Keep firing for** field. This is how long the alert keeps firing after the condition resolves, so a metric bouncing across the threshold doesn't flap. Leave it at **None** for this rule — you can raise it later if you see the alert flip on and off.
Your alert now has a folder, a label, and an evaluation schedule. Next, you'll pick who gets notified when the alert fires.
